value.rationale: An integral pairing is a natural complete middle-dimensional invariant stronger than numerical Hodge and known vertical Schubert data. The claim classifies a 632-dimensional odd unimodular form, proves a distinguished 630-dimensional orthogonal complement is even despite the ambient form being odd, and specifies its full 84-element quadratic discriminant and unique isometry class. These integral gluing data bear directly on algebraic four-cycles and characteristic flux shifts. The older table supplies needed inputs but not this integral refinement; no arbitrary slice or mere rank recomputation is claimed.
